payload.name: Implied venue locations in trip plans
payload.description: When extracting or updating a plan/event memory about a trip to a named major venue with widely known location(s), include the implied states or city, unless the user already states the location.
content: During extraction or any update of a plan/event memory, if the destination is a major, well-known venue whose location is common knowledge and the user did not state it, add the venue's canonical location(s) (e.g., state or city) to the memory content.
Stop after adding the canonical known location(s); do not infer locations for obscure or ambiguous venues, and do not add any location the source message does not support.

solves: Plan/event candidates often record a named destination while dropping its implicit location, so later 'which states might they be in' questions cannot be answered from memory. This applies when a future session mentions a trip to a major venue with widely known locations, requiring those implied states to be stored during extraction. It does not apply when the user already specifies the location or when the venue's location is not common knowledge.
